args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. None flagged; all 8 cleared (r01–r08).
Checks: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections passed on every run. The width-free ratio was not used, and no run had a roll back.
Profiles: the centre strain-rate (REGR) peak is at 421 µm and the largest flank difference is at 410 µm in every run. The REGR peak ranges from 52.77 to 52.92 %/h.
Large |z| values: the batch spread is very small (REGR MAD 0.025 %/h, growth-zone MAD 5 µm), so small differences give large |z|. r08's REGR peak (z 3.37) is only 0.125 %/h, about 0.2%, above the median. The 674 µm growth zones in r01, r07 and r08 (z -3.51) are 26 µm, about 4%, shorter than the median. Neither difference is a fault.
Remedies: r01 and r07 each kept one remedy, and all checks pass on the final measurement, which is the normal path.
Note: r03, r04 and r06 have exactly the same checks and summaries as r02, and r07 matches r01 the same way. It's worth confirming that these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries.
No flagged runs, so they have nothing in common to report.
